sources.locator: How To Order (型号表示法) section: ordering-code figure and tables Size Code, Dielectric Code, Nominal Capacitance, Capacitance Tolerance, Rated Voltage, Terminal Material Styles, Package Styles; Product Structure figure
sources.evidence_extract: Code order: size / dielectric / capacitance / tolerance / rated voltage / termination / package (example 0805 CG 102 K 500 N T). Size 0603 = 1.60x0.80 mm; dielectric B = X7R; capacitance pF, 2 significant digits + number of zeros; K = +/-10%; rated voltage 500 = 50x10^0 V; N = Nickel Barrier termination; T = 7 inch tape reel (编带 7 寸盘包装). Product Structure: ceramic dielectric, inner electrode, two outer electrodes with Ni and Sn layers. Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C57112 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C57112.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, 1049175 bytes, starts %PDF-, 30 pages (28 printed)): fcbcad908c6c321869c5ef7948315c2fe84700c50cf2e2e415e12de023482b2a - no A5 baseline.
